channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Javier Bardem shares how he embodied villain Max Cady in Apple TV's 'Cape Fear'

item.title: Trump administration's decision to let USMCA lapse threatens Texas economy

item.title: Rural California school district creates space where kids can learn to swim
item.description: Not everyone has access to a public pool. But a rural school district in California just pulled together funding for a new aquatic center so kids can learn to swim.
